correctness.rationale: The periodic gap coverage proof is necessary and sufficient for domination. For each selected vertex, the integer interval for a private closed-neighborhood witness is nonempty exactly when its adjacent gaps sum to at least 2r+2; the periodic order rules out nonneighbor interference. Cyclic word rooting gives the exact n/k factor. The formal matrix trace/log determinant identity derives every coefficient, and the pair-sum extremal arguments prove complete support and parity. An independent adjacency-level brute-force verifier passes 32 graphs, 85,304 direct nonempty subset tests and 35 parity instances. Finite tests are corroboration, not proof.

value.rationale: A natural infinite circulant family receives a complete cardinality-refined classification of every inclusion-minimal dominating set, not a scalar minimum or a single computational sample. The adjacent-gap obstruction yields a finite rational transfer system for every power and a nontrivial no-gap cardinality spectrum. At the maximum cardinality, the exact odd/even quotient multiplicity jump is a structural rigidity phenomenon and has natural significance for upper domination and configuration counting. The r=1 univariate special case is acknowledged prior art.
